title: Voice AI Qualification Schema
description: Data model and scoring logic for inbound caller qualification. Redacted template.

scoring_criteria.description: Each criterion is weighted. Replace placeholders with your real qualifying signals.

intent_clarity.description: How clearly the caller expressed a buying need

timeline.description: How soon they need a solution

decision_power.description: Whether the caller is a decision maker

tier_1_high_intent.description: Fire the human alert immediately, regardless of whether they book.

tier_2_qualified.description: Move straight to booking and send the calendar link.

tier_3_nurture.description: Not ready now. Capture details and enter the nurture cadence.

tier_4_capture.description: Low signal. Capture contact info so no caller is ever a dead end.
